meta.name: splitport
meta.author: yandujun363
meta.description: Client-side only: reads the separate TCP and UDP ports from the _mindustry._tcp and _mindustry._udp SRV records, so you can join servers whose NAT exposes a different external port for each protocol. Falls back to the vanilla single-port logic whenever no SRV record answers, adds no content, and is hidden from the multiplayer mod handshake so servers without it never kick you.
